item.tib: dra ba nag po'i shog dril
item.coloph: 'di ni gshen po hris pa gyer med kyis khol du bkol ba'o/ dam med la gsang / sham po'i gter ma'o/ sprul sku rma ston gyis dngos grub rim gyis brgyud pa'o/ dam med dpe rkun srog gi gshed mar shog/

item.tib: zhi khro ye shes kyi skong rdzogs chen mo
item.coloph: gshen gsang ba 'dus pa/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar/ lha bon yongs su dag pa/ klu grub ye shes snying po bzhi yis mdzad pa'i bka'/ dbang chen zhi khro'i skong bshags/ las dang skal pa ldan zhing sgrub pa zung thub pa/ dam tshig mi g.yel bsrung dang 'phrad par shog shog ser dngul mgo g.yung drung can la rka (dka') ba bcad/ bsam yas ca ti dmar po'i gter ma'o/ rdzong brag bla ma dbu brnal la rim gyis brgyud pa'o//
